problem_statement: Indian founders who incorporate a US subsidiary (typically an India LLP parent + Delaware C-Corp) alongside their India-based operating entity cannot see or manage their finances as one connected system. Revenue, payroll, ledgers, transfer pricing, and statutory compliance obligations live in disconnected spreadsheets, bank portals, and accountant workflows across two jurisdictions, so founders lack a single source of truth for cash position, intercompany pricing, and the interlocking India (GST/TDS/EPF/ESI/Sec 40(b)/194T) and US (Form 5472, transfer pricing, federal/state tax) filing obligations that a cross-border structure creates. This causes missed or last-minute filings, manual and error-prone TDS/GST/transfer-pricing calculations, and no reliable way to know current compliance status.

primary.persona: Indian solo/small-team founder or LLP partner running a US-facing SaaS or services business
primary.context: Owns an India LLP (or Pvt Ltd) that is the parent of a Delaware/US C-Corp subsidiary; handles US customer billing (Stripe/Lemon Squeezy) and India-side payroll/partner remuneration personally, without an in-house finance team
primary.pain: No unified view of ledger, transfer pricing, payroll TDS/PF, and GST/US filing deadlines; relies on ad hoc spreadsheets and external accountants; risks non-compliance and manual calculation errors

secondary.context: Prepares GST, TDS, and tax-audit filings for the founder
secondary.pain: Needs clean, exportable, form-specific data (GSTR-1/3B, 24Q/26Q, Form 5472) rather than generic CSV/TXT dumps

secondary.context: Issues employee documents, manages payroll runs, tracks leave
secondary.pain: Manual document issuance and no batch payroll processing

technical: Golden path: TypeScript, React + Vite frontend, Node.js + Express API, SQLite persistence, Vitest + RTL, npm
Current codebase persists primarily to browser localStorage with SQLite as export/hydration snapshot — architecture gap to flag at Gate 2
No authentication/session layer exists yet; app is currently single-user, browser-only
Third-party integrations: Stripe (live sync), Google Gemini / Anthropic Claude (AI compliance assistant), Mercury Bank (partial), Nodemailer (SMTP), jsPDF/pptxgenjs
Hardcoded FX rate (USD/INR ~83.5) with no dynamic rate source
regulatory: India: GST (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9/9C, OIDAR), TDS/TCS (24Q, 26Q, 27Q, 194T, 194Q/194A/194J), EPF/ESI, Professional Tax, Sec 40(b), LLP Tax Audit (44AB), FEMA/RBI (ODI, FIRC, SOFTEX)
US: Form 5472, transfer pricing / arm's-length, federal/state corporate tax (1120), 1099 contractor reporting
Cross-border: DTAA treaty relief, withholding tax on payments to non-residents (195/1441/1442), TRC/Form 10F
constraints.budget: Not stated — inferred bootstrapped/solo-founder tooling budget

explicit_features: Multi-entity onboarding wizard (India parent + US subsidiary profile, payroll config, accounting config)
Revenue ingestion: Stripe live sync, mock mode, OIDAR/export classification by customer country
General ledger, Balance Sheet, P&L, journal entries, GST Center (GSTR-1/3B drafts, ITC calc)
Payroll: employee directory, salary slips, EPF/PT/TDS calc, Sec 194T partner TDS, leave management
Transfer pricing calculator with post-to-ledger intercompany transaction creation
Tax Engine: book profit, Sec 40(b) partner remuneration, US 21% tax estimate, Form 5472 draft context
Compliance Hub: digital document vault, filing calendar, statutory report downloads
Admin panel: document issuer, platform rules (FX markup, audit threshold), module permissions
AI assistant (Gemini/Claude) for compliance Q&A with query history
Foreign income records, withholding payments, tax treaties, US tax draft, Contractor 1099, remittance records
excluded_features: Real bank feed integrations beyond partial Mercury/Stripe
Schema-compliant regulatory filing generation (current exports are generic CSV/TXT placeholders)
Edit/delete on ledger transactions and employee records (append-only currently)

scale_expectation.at_launch: Single organisation / single founder-operator, low transaction volume
scale_expectation.one_year: Small number of India-US founder organisations (tens), single-tenant-per-browser unless multi-tenant auth added
scale_expectation.three_years: Not determinable — would require multi-tenant SaaS rearchitecture

monetization_hint: Not specified — inferred internal tool or pre-monetization MVP for future subscription/per-entity pricing
existing_systems: Spreadsheets and manual accountant workflows (implied predecessor)
Google Gemini API / Anthropic Claude API (integrated)

evidence_sources.description: Committed SQLite snapshot: org, ledger, employees, SMTP settings
Domain model entities — usable as requirements/entity seed
Live/test integration hooks for Mercury, Gemini, Claude, Stripe
No issue tracker or support ticket export detected — gap

initial_requirement_seed.business: REQ-B-001: The system shall provide a founder of an India-LLP-parent / US-C-Corp-subsidiary structure a single consolidated view of financial position and compliance status across both entities.
initial_requirement_seed.functional: REQ-F-001: The system shall classify each revenue transaction by customer country and income type (export of services, OIDAR, domestic) and derive the applicable GST treatment automatically.
initial_requirement_seed.non_functional: REQ-NF-001: All statutory report exports (GSTR-1/3B, Form 24Q/26Q, Form 5472) shall be schema-compliant/machine-validatable for the target filing format.
initial_requirement_seed.user: REQ-U-001: As a founder, I want to run a monthly payroll batch (EPF/ESI/PT/TDS computed per employee) and download filing-ready 24Q data.
initial_requirement_seed.external_interface: REQ-EI-001: The system shall synchronize transaction data from Stripe (implemented) and, per roadmap, Lemon Squeezy and Mercury Bank, normalizing all sources into a common Transaction schema.
